author: cosmicbatty
body:
Oh golly I'm so sorry for yet another long hiatus! As soon as I started to play again something popped up.
Anyway I'm back with a new username for security reasons. I used to be gaiaxles or Totodile_Love!

I hope I can permanently stay, although I will have trouble getting on after my birthday due to laptop issues.
